# Fallout 76 - Patch notes for the "America's Playground" update (03/25/2024 / Patch 50)

![Fallout 76 - Patch notes for the `America's Playground` update (03/25/2024 / Patch 50)](/uploads/324_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Last year, the expedition to Atlantic City allowed you to meet new characters and explore previously unknown places. Now it's time to take care of unfinished business.

UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

**America's Playground** Return to Atlantic City and join Mayor Tim in the fight against the Overgrown invasion. - New Questline - Uncover a deadly conspiracy hidden behind the Russo family's glamorous façade in this multi-mission questline.
**Explore the Boardwalk** See more of our vision of post-nuclear New Jersey in this update. Explore new areas of the city and take on new side quests. There are also new characters, so come say hello!
**Season Changes** We've overhauled our season system to give you more flexibility in earning rewards. You can find more details about this in the Seasonal Changes section below.

UPDATE VERSION 1.7.10.12 AND DOWNLOAD SIZEHere you can find out the download size of today's update on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam)**: 17.1GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 27.1GB
**Xbox**: 27.08GB
**PlayStation**: 26.1GB

ATLANTIC CITY - AMERICA'S PLAYGROUND During your last visit to Atlantic City, you were able to take part in a deadly entertainers' game show and meet the family - the local organized crime group. Now the head of Atlantic City's municipal government, Mayor Tim, is asking for your help in combating an overgrown invasion. Will you be able to stop the dangerous plant-like creatures that have a stranglehold on Atlantic City in this all-new expedition mission? FAMILY OVER ALL - ALL-NEW QUEST SERIES At home in Appalachia, players can complete a new, multi-mission quest series centered around the glamorous Russo family. Hoping to live a quieter yet comfortable life away from the hectic rat race of Atlantic City, the Russos open a nightclub in Appalachia. Unfortunately, the chances of this happening are extremely slim: As deadly events unfold, players are forced to retrieve the bodies (or rather devils) of the Russo family from the basement in this new quest for Fallout 76. EXPLORE THE PROMENADEAtlantic City - America's Playground also continues to build on Fallout's version of post-nuclear New Jersey and gives players the chance to explore the city at their leisure or take on new side quests. Get to know the local merchants and shop diligently or influence the events in the family when it comes to who from your inner circle will take the reins next! SEASON CHANGES
![S16 Page01](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/1Gz7oUCle0mHw0PDA4wUAW/5a92b738c205cf4dd194214826184fa5/S16_Seasons_FullHud_1.png) The game board transforms into the new, improved Season screen! At the start of each season, you can now see all the exciting rewards you can earn - even rewards beyond Rank 100! Rewards are divided into several pages, which you unlock by reaching the respective rank. With each new rank you will receive 25 tickets, which you can then redeem for rewards on the activated sites. Just like on the game board, you increase your rank by completing challenges and thereby earning S.C.O.R.E. earned.

**Please note**: Make sure to redeem all of your tickets before the end of the season. Unused tickets expire and cannot be transferred to the next page
